# Blender Agent Studio

This repository is a Codex and Claude Code plugin marketplace containing the
`blender-agent-studio` plugin.

Install in Codex:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ifBars/blender-agent-studio
codex plugin add blender-agent-studio@blender-agent-studio
```

Install in Claude Code:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add ifBars/blender-agent-studio
claude plugin install blender-agent-studio@blender-agent-studio
```

Core capabilities:

- reproducible procedural Blender modeling;
- authored-scene and fresh-export validation;
- standardized multiview and animation evidence;
- adaptive studio presentation with explicit neutral, dark, and light presets;
- Astra-aware workflows and explicit Astra/Sol/Terra/Luna benchmark profiles;
- mechanical animation guidance;
- isolated baseline/plugin/MCP agent benchmarks;
- a bounded local MCP for evaluation and authored-camera rendering, with scene preflight and inline PNG review.

The plugin source is under `plugins/blender-agent-studio/`. Generated models,
renders, exports, and benchmark runs are intentionally excluded from git.
